versions.label: teacher-free: MC-value monitor, FREE or SELECT(4) per line, fallback when all values are 0
greedy lookahead per line: SELECT / teacher hint / FINISH with a passing rollout, union-bound accounting
teacher-free trajectory rejection: doubling rollout pools, bits = log2(rollouts drawn)
hint ladder probed before enough plain rejection (flawed order: expensive hint hits end the run)
plain rejection up to 512 rollouts first, then hint ladder from cheapest; budget to min s(h) + log2 1/V(h)
plain rejection up to 512; teacher selects a near-miss among the first 16 attempts and repairs its first wrong line (log2 16 + s), then rejection
v4b hint ladder and v5 repairs as competing sources; budget to min log-multiplicity + log2 1/V
v6 sources, up to 8192 rollouts per source; plain rollouts compete with teacher text by estimated cost; prefixes costlier than the fallback are never used
v7 with style-matched one-line hints: the teacher sees the student's failed attempts and proposes 8 short lines
v8 plus up to 2 more teacher rounds that see each tried hint's measured surprisal and success rate
teacher rewrites the solution in the student's style (from its failed attempts); every line-prefix is a hint source (the frontier teacher's method, automated)
